description: "The Cock-House at Fellsgarth" by Talbot Baines Reed is a novel set in a 19th-century boys' boarding school. The story revolves around the experiences of new boys as they navigate the complexities of school life, friendship, and rivalry, particularly amid the ongoing conflict between the Classical and Modern factions at the school.
